chunk.content: Yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares), one species within Fishora's genus-level tuna label, has a medium flavour, medium oiliness and moist flesh that quickly becomes dry if overcooked; the cooked flesh is creamy brown, breaks into large flakes and has very few bones.
chunk.source_quote: Has a medium flavour, medium oiliness and moist flesh, which quickly becomes dry if overcooked. The cooked flesh is creamy brown in colour and breaks into large flakes; there are very few bones to worry about.
